title: Booker T. Washington High School and schoolmates
summary: He says he registered at one school but attended Booker T. with James Rivers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Did you go to, I think it was a green high school with James Rivers? I think you were like a year or two ahead of him. I think an Art Neville and James Black.

Not green school, I don't think. I registered for a green school one year. I think it was when it was, well, I don't know what was going on during that period, but it was some sort of transitional period going on. And I registered, but I didn't go to that school green. So I didn't get that. James Rivers and I went to Booker T together.
